title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
version: 2026-05-29 non-European targeted Li Ye and related reader repair
description:
Dedicated record for non-European and multilingual mathematical manuscripts in the Modern LaTeX Editions project. It currently contains Chinese, Indian/Sanskrit, Islamic/Arabic, and historical-reference mathematical works as modern-LaTeX reader PDFs, translation drafts, source files, and preservation artifacts.

Current public surface. The top-level PDFs are the current render-checked work-level set: [######----] 40 reader PDFs / 1462 pages.   • Source/provenance preservation: [##########] source bundles, OCR text, page images, audit notes, and broader drafts are retained in ZIP artifacts.
